name: Dusty
description: Clean mode: black screen and a locked keyboard and trackpad for 5 to 60 seconds. ⌘⇧C ends it.
author: Giuseppe
details: A clean mode for wiping the keyboard and the trackpad without pressing anything by mistake. Pick 5 to 60 seconds: the screen goes black and the keyboard, trackpad and mouse stop answering. ⌘⇧C ends it at once.
features: Refuses to start if it can't lock the keyboard
permissions: Needs the Accessibility permission, to be able to ignore the keyboard and the pointer.
